reader.requirement: At --std 85, SET Format 3 (SET {mnemonic-name-1}... TO {ON|OFF}, the phrase repeatable) must change the status of each external switch associated with each mnemonic-name-1 so that a later switch-status condition-name (ON STATUS / OFF STATUS of SPECIAL-NAMES, §1985:VI.6.3.1.4) evaluates as on after ON and off after OFF, for every receiver of every phrase in order, including from a contained program and through a condition-name declared for only one of the two statuses.

edition-consulted.switches: nothing behavioural: BoundRejected.Reported(ctx.Edition) only carries the edition context when an SR5 receiver is refused

reader.edition-search: grep of Edition|CobolVersion|Std in SetAlterBinder.cs, SpecialNamesBinder.cs, ConfigurationNames.cs, AlterSwitchEmitter.cs; grep of Switch|VisitSet in Validation/VersionConformancePass.cs (no VisitSetSwitchStatement: only SetBoolean/SetTo/SetLocale/SetContent/SetLastException visits). SpecialNamesBinder uses Edition only for Edition.At locations and Edition.Error diagnostics. The runtime SwitchStore has no edition input.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness sets one switch with one receiver per phrase and tests it through EVALUATE; not exercised: several receivers in one phrase, several phrases in one SET, a condition-name declared for only one status, a contained program, the environment-supplied initial status

probes.printed: A1 ON / A1OFF F / B1OFF F / C1 OFF / A2 OFF / A2OFF T / B2 NOTOFF / C2 ON / A3 OFF / IN-A OFF / A4 ON
probes.expected: SET SWA SWB TO ON SWC TO OFF: A-ON true, A-OFF false, B-OFF false, C-ON false; then SWA OFF, SWB SWC ON; SET SWA TO ON SWA TO OFF leaves A off (left to right); a contained program INNER sees the container's condition-name (§1985:VI.4.5.4 GR1) and its SET TO ON is seen by the container

probes.printed: error COBOL1757: SET 'CONS' TO ON ... 'CONS' is the mnemonic-name of the device-name 'CONSOLE'
probes.expected: refused: mnemonic-name-1 must be associated with an external switch (§1985:VI.6.23.3 SR5)

probes.printed: error COBOL1757 (a switch-status condition-name A-ON as the operand)
error COBOL1757: 'SWITCH-1' is itself a switch-name, an implementor-name
error COBOL2269 for SET SWA (1) TO ON
probes.expected: refused: a mnemonic-name takes no subscript

probes.printed: error COBOL1639: SET 'SWA' TO TRUE — 'SWA' is not a condition-name
probes.expected: refused: Format 4 takes a condition-name of a conditional variable (§1985:VI.6.23.3 SR6)

probes.printed: A OFF without the environment; A ON with COBOL_SWITCH_1=ON
probes.expected: the initial status is implementor-defined (documented DOC-A.1-191); a switch with no SET reflects it

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.23.4 GR6  (6.23.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6

reader.notes: One grammar unit per printed phrase, one binder loop over every receiver of every phrase, one emitted ExternalSwitches.Set per receiver in source order, and the switch-status condition reads the same run-unit store; no member on the path branches on the edition. The SR5 diagnostics cite §2023 clause numbers at --std 85 (a diagnostic-text matter of other rules, not of GR6).

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.6.23.2 Format 3, VI.6.23.3 SR5, VI.6.23.4 GR6. SwitchStore (Runtime/Control/SwitchStore.cs) is keyed by the implementor switch-name and scoped to the run unit, so GR6's 'a condition-name associated with that switch' is reached from any program. Probes (run_case.py, --std 85): refute-1985-018/s1-001: MAINP sets SWITCH-1 through mnemonic SWA, which has no condition-name; separately compiled SUBP declares SWITCH-1 ON/OFF STATUS only and prints SUB S1 ON / NOT OFF, then NOT ON / OFF after SET SWA TO OFF; SUBP2 sets SWITCH-2 OFF through its own mnemonic, and MAINP's B-ON then reads OFF. s3-001: SET SWC SWU TO ON SWC TO OFF SWU TO OFF SWU TO ON gives C OFF / U ON / OK2 (phrases left to right, UPSI-0 with only an ON condition-name). s2-001 (class c): SET C-ON TO FALSE is refused, COBOL0900 'SET condition-name TO FALSE requires COBOL-2002' plus COBOL1757. Edition grep of SetAlterBinder.cs and AlterSwitchEmitter.cs: only BoundRejected.Reported(ctx.Edition); VersionConformancePass has no SET-switch visit. cite: OK  §1985:VI.6.23.4 GR6  (6.23.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6
